newsitem.title: USA: Campbell to sell German chilled food unit.
newsitem.headline: Campbell to sell German chilled food unit.

text.p: Campbell Soup Company said Wednesday it will sell its Germany-based Beeck-Feinkost GmbH chilled foods businesss to Gilde Buy-Out Fund, a Dutch venture capital firm.
Campbell, which bought the privately held gourmet salad and deli products business in 1987, said the unit's 1996 sales were about $65 million.
The sale, expected to be completed by June, is part of Campbell's previously announced plan to divest non-strategic businesses, the giant food company said.
Although terms of the deal were not disclosed, Campbell said Beeck managers will participate with Gilde in the purchase.
The sale includes the Beeck brand name and related assets, including two manufacturing facilities in Hamburg and Cuxhaven which employ about 360 people.
Gilde Buy-Out Fund is managed by Gilde Investment Management, a global venture capital investor based in Utrecht, The Netherlands.
Campbell announced earlier this month the sale of its Marie's salad dressing and dip business to Dean Foods.
